title: Choose the new look for your portfolio
question: The roll dealt Station Signs. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Station Signs
options.lineage: Japanese railway wayfinding: station signboards (駅名標) and route maps (路線図)
options.thesis: Your career as a rail line: every section is a station, and the reviewer rides it.
options.viewport: A route map runs across the top with CDC, Biz Solution and NBC as stations, the current one lit. Below it, a full-width station signboard shows the section name in JA and EN, with previous and next stations at its foot.
options.risk: Pushed too far it turns into train-themed kitsch; the bullets and dates must stay plain and scannable under the signs.

raised.raise: Time as material: every work station's sign carries its own duration band (4 months, now).
Three-dye discipline per station (line colour, sign white, ink), and only the current station inverts on the map.
The facts board keeps fixed columns between stations; only the values change, row by row.
Station buttons on the map have real press travel, so the pressed state reads as pressed.
Platform rhythm: generous zones between sign, content and facts board, like marked platform areas.

regions.label: route map: CDC · Biz · Biz · NBC  |  branch: skills · credentials · contact
station signboard: name JA + EN, line band, duration

options.label: Rirekisho, in full colour
options.lineage: the JIS 履歴書 form every Japanese reviewer reads daily
options.thesis: The résumé form your reviewer knows by heart, printed in one bold ink and stamped where it matters.
materials: ruled form grid in one saturated ink
photo in the 写真 box
hanko seal on the current role
options.viewport: A wide ruled form fills the screen: your photo sits in the photo box, name and role in the header cells, and the history table opens on NBC with a red seal.
options.risk: The most familiar of all for this audience, and the one most at risk of reading stiff, which you flagged as wrong.

options.label: Sliding Planes
options.lineage: the Rietveld Schröder house, primary planes that reconfigure one room
options.thesis: One room that slides into each section: coloured planes move, and the page is the composition you operate.
materials: primary colour only on moving edges
options.viewport: Your name and role sit on one white plane; a red plane slides aside to reveal NBC, and every section is a plane position.
options.case: Fuses cleanly and navigation is very clear; loses on recognition, since Dutch modernism is not your reviewer's world.
options.risk: Can tip into playful if the planes move for show rather than to reveal content.

options.label: Depot Destination Blind
options.lineage: bus and tram destination roll signs (方向幕)
options.thesis: Sections roll past one fixed window like a destination blind.
options.viewport: One fixed window, the current section's legend stopped in it.
options.case: One-size condensed caps make long bullets hard to scan; loses on clarity and on recognition next to station signs.
options.kept: Three-dye discipline, and only the current item inverts.
options.risk: All-caps legends tire the eye on real prose.

options.label: Split-flap Concourse
options.thesis: Your roles as departures on a split-flap board.
options.viewport: A board of rows: role, employer, period, flipping in.
options.case: Reads as a gimmick for four roles and drifts toward tech costume; loses both axes.
options.kept: Fixed columns that never reflow; only values change.
options.risk: Novelty wears off after the first flip.

options.label: CD-ROM Console
options.thesis: A beveled console with your record in a small window.
options.viewport: A rendered machine framing a small content window.
options.case: Too playful for a central-bank engineer, which you flagged as wrong; loses both axes.

options.label: Pickling Brine Calendar
options.thesis: Roles as jars maturing on a shelf.
options.viewport: A shelf of labelled jars, one per role.
options.case: No link to backend work or to the reviewer; loses both axes.
options.kept: Time as visible material: each item carries its own duration.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.viewport: Stacked white blocks with blue gaps.
options.case: Dreamlike and vague where the reviewer needs facts; loses both axes.
options.kept: Deep, deliberate gaps between blocks of content.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A classic developer portfolio, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Name and role large, a short intro, then experience, skills and contact.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other developer portfolio by design.
